data.about: A triangular single-panel truss: pin at A, roller at B, load F at the apex C. The antiresultant F′ on the load's line of action is split by a trial funicular into two reactions parallel to F through A and B; the roller then forces its reaction vertical — B_V acts through O′ and the pin takes A_V + A_H. The members close the force polygon: compression in the legs, tension in the bottom chord.
